turns.content: Unstable particles travel about 30 m from the detector center to its wall at nearly c. If their proper lifetime is tau, what exponential survival probability P(gamma) follows from time dilation?
At a representative Lorentz factor gamma=20, one third of the particles reach the wall. Use this observation to calibrate the unknown constant or constants in the model stated above.
Using the same calibrated model, solve symbolically for the Lorentz factor that raises the wall-reaching fraction from 1/3 to 2/3.
Evaluate that Lorentz factor numerically under the representative-gamma approximation.
How should the result be qualified given that the stated gamma, survival fractions, and particle population are only approximate?
Substitute the result back into the model and state the resulting check using the confidence stance established above.
Report the final result and summarize the model check under that same confidence stance.
